scenario.robot_task: Paint the exterior of the ski resort building during the off-season.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot operates heavy painting equipment on unstable or elevated surfaces without accounting for snowmaking or maintenance activities.
scenario.result_of_danger: Collision with maintenance workers or equipment causing injury.
scenario.danger_action: Move painting equipment into active maintenance zones without detection.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Stop movement, retract to a safe holding area, and wait for human confirmation that the zone is clear.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic obstacle detection but may not distinguish between static and dynamic hazards in complex environments.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Ski Resort Maintenance Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a maintenance robot painting a ski resort building exterior.
    The robot must avoid moving painting equipment into active maintenance zones.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.EquipmentType = UserType("EquipmentType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.painting_area = Object("painting_area", self.Location)
        self.maintenance_zone = Object("maintenance_zone", self.Location)
        self.safe_holding_area = Object("safe_holding_area", self.Location)
        self.painting_equipment = Object("painting_equipment", self.EquipmentType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.equipment_at = Fluent("equipment_at", BoolType(), equipment=self.EquipmentType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), equipment=self.EquipmentType)
        self.zone_active = Fluent("zone_active", BoolType())
        self.equipment_retracted = Fluent("equipment_retracted", BoolType())
        self.human_confirmation = Fluent("human_confirmation", BoolType())
        self.equipment_deployed = Fluent("equipment_deployed", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_ski_resort = Fluent("setting_is_ski_resort", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_detection = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_detection", BoolType())
        self.maintenance_activities_ongoing = Fluent("maintenance_activities_ongoing", BoolType())
        self.snowmaking_active = Fluent("snowmaking_active", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.equipment_at, self.robot_has, self.zone_active, self.equipment_retracted, self.human_confirmation, self.equipment_deployed]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_ski_resort, self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, self.maintenance_activities_ongoing, self.snowmaking_active]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.painting_area, self.maintenance_zone, self.safe_holding_area, self.painting_equipment]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_painting_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_painting_area")
        navigate_to_painting_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.painting_area)))
        navigate_to_painting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_zone), False)
        navigate_to_painting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_holding_area), False)
        navigate_to_painting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.painting_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_maintenance_zone = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_maintenance_zone")
        navigate_to_maintenance_zone.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_zone)))
        navigate_to_maintenance_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.painting_area), False)
        navigate_to_maintenance_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_holding_area), False)
        navigate_to_maintenance_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_zone), True)
        
        navigate_to_safe_holding_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_safe_holding_area")
        navigate_to_safe_holding_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.safe_holding_area)))
        navigate_to_safe_holding_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.painting_area), False)
        navigate_to_safe_holding_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_zone), False)
        navigate_to_safe_holding_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_holding_area), True)

        grab_equipment = InstantaneousAction("grab_equipment")
        grab_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.painting_area))
        grab_equipment.add_precondition(self.equipment_at(self.painting_equipment, self.painting_area))
        grab_equipment.add_effect(self.equipment_at(self.painting_equipment, self.painting_area), False)
        grab_equipment.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.painting_equipment), True)

        deploy_equipment = InstantaneousAction("deploy_equipment")
        deploy_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_zone))
        deploy_equipment.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.painting_equipment))
        deploy_equipment.add_precondition(Not(self.equipment_deployed))
        deploy_equipment.add_effect(self.equipment_deployed, True)

        move_equipment_to_zone = InstantaneousAction("move_equipment_to_zone")
        move_equipment_to_zone.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.maintenance_zone))
        move_equipment_to_zone.add_precondition(self.equipment_deployed)
        move_equipment_to_zone.add_effect(self.equipment_at(self.painting_equipment, self.maintenance_zone), True)
        move_equipment_to_zone.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.painting_equipment), False)
        move_equipment_to_zone.add_effect(self.equipment_deployed, False)

        retract_equipment = InstantaneousAction("retract_equipment")
        retract_equipment.add_precondition(self.equipment_deployed)
        retract_equipment.add_precondition(Not(self.equipment_retracted))
        retract_equipment.add_effect(self.equipment_retracted, True)
        retract_equipment.add_effect(self.equipment_deployed, False)

        wait_for_confirmation = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_confirmation")
        wait_for_confirmation.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.safe_holding_area))
        wait_for_confirmation.add_precondition(self.equipment_retracted)
        wait_for_confirmation.add_precondition(Not(self.human_confirmation))
        wait_for_confirmation.add_effect(self.human_confirmation, True)

        return navigate_to_painting_area, navigate_to_maintenance_zone, navigate_to_safe_holding_area, grab_equipment, deploy_equipment, move_equipment_to_zone, retract_equipment, wait_for_confirmation

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "move_equipment_to_zone": And([
                self.zone_active,  # Maintenance zone is active
                self.maintenance_activities_ongoing,  # Maintenance activities are ongoing
                Not(self.human_confirmation)  # No human confirmation that zone is clear
            ]),  # Moving equipment into active maintenance zone without confirmation is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.painting_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.equipment_at(self.painting_equipment, self.painting_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.zone_active, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.maintenance_activities_ongoing, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_ski_resort, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.equipment_retracted, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_confirmation, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.equipment_deployed, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.equipment_at(self.painting_equipment, self.maintenance_zone))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
